notes: Comes from 'dondurmak' (to freeze). When meaning 'ice cream', stress is on the middle syllable (don-DUR-ma); when meaning the act of freezing or 'don't freeze!', stress is on the last syllable (don-dur-MA).

faults.why: The noun meaning 'ice cream' has stress on the penult (/donˈduɾma/), while the verbal noun has final stress.

faults.quote: Etin dondurma işlemi birkaç saat sürer.
faults.why: Unnatural Turkish phrasing; native speakers say 'Eti dondurma işlemi' (accusative) or 'Et dondurma işlemi'.
